dct_title_s: Lombok Indonesia Magnitude 6.4 Earthquake Interferogram using Sentinel 1 data
dct_description_sm: An Interferogram of the devastating earthquake in Indonesia last July 29, 2018 with a magnitude of 6.4. Data were processed using 2 Sentinel 1 data using repeat pass interferometry. One cycle (cold to hot color) means half of the radar wavelength which is approximately 3.5 - 7.5 cm wavelength. The data shows vertical ground displacement with respect to the satellites line of sight (LOS).
